description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'git rebase --abort' functionality. It sets up test scenarios, executes rebase operations, and verifies the expected behaviors through success or failure assertions. The script is part of a test suite for Git's rebase features.

methods.name: check_head
methods.description: A helper function that verifies the current HEAD matches 'pre-rebase' and the current branch is 'to-rebase'.

methods.name: testrebase
methods.description: A function that runs a series of tests for different rebase types (' --apply' and ' --merge'), checking the correctness of the '--abort' operation under various scenarios.
